methods.name: Quests for the early levels
methods.note: Enter the Abyss, Temple of the Eye, The Eyes of Glouphrie and others skip to about 32. Temple of the Eye unlocks the Rift.

methods.name: Fire talisman tiaras
methods.note: Talisman on the altar with a tiara, 1,450 an hour. Fastest start with no requirements but click-heavy. Lavas win from 50.

methods.name: Arceuus Library books
methods.note: Each book gives 5x your level. Rate is 150 books an hour with a client plugin. Expect two thirds of that without one.

methods.name: Ourania Altar
methods.note: Lower-effort than lavas and profitable. Ourania Teleport, all pouches, pay Eniola in runes to bank. Worlds 327 and 480.

methods.name: Lava runes with Magic Imbue
methods.note: Fire Altar with earth runes, binding necklace and all pouches. Rates are for a competent player. Learners get 50 to 90 percent.

methods.name: Lava runes with earth talismans
methods.note: Same route without the Lunar spellbook. One to three earth talismans a lap and pouch repairs at Cordelia or the Dark Mage.

methods.name: Lavas or aethers with essence runners
methods.note: Four runners on lavas, six on aethers from 90. Runners cost about 12 to 15m an hour each. Duo lavas are about 162,000.

methods.name: Guardians of the Rift
methods.note: No essence needed. Passive Mining and Crafting XP plus the Raiments and colossal pouch. Rates from 85 assume a small team.

methods.name: Royal Titans desiccated pages
methods.note: Forfeit boss loot for pages worth 50 XP each. About 20,000 an hour each in a duo with high combat stats.

methods.name: Arceuus blood runes, soul runes at 90
methods.note: Mine dense essence, bless at the Dark Altar, chisel and craft. Low effort and profitable. Rates assume the Kourend medium diary.

methods.name: Double astral runes
methods.note: Tele Group Moonclan to the altar and bank at Castle Wars. Good profit with the Raiments. Up to 59,000 at 99.

methods.name: Aether runes
methods.note: Soul runes on the Cosmic Altar with aether catalyst via the POH fairy ring. Only 70,000 without a colossal pouch.

methods.name: Wrath runes
methods.note: Mythical cape to the Myths' Guild and run past the dragons with dragonfire protection. 75 to 85 runs an hour.

unverified: Quests for the early levels: one-off quest XP, no hourly rate in the guide (xph 0)
Guardians of the Rift: neither guide gives a rate below level 40 (table starts at 40-50: 25,000), so xph at 27 is 0

Ourania Altar: the guide's XP/h cells are wiki formulas (xp per essence x essence per lap x seconds / 48). Bands are those formulas evaluated, not quoted numbers. 71 Magic is 'strongly recommended' rather than a hard requirement (tablets work)
Lava runes: the guide's XP/h cells are stored unrounded and displayed rounded to the nearest 100. Bands use the rounded figures. Below 85 the bands use the best non-colossal pouch set
Arceuus Library: bands use the guide's 150 books/hour column (needs client plugin). The 100 books/hour column is two thirds of each figure
Royal Titans desiccated pages: no combat or quest requirement is stated in the guide beyond 'high combat stats'
Aether runes: Lunar Diplomacy is inferred from the Magic Imbue requirement. The aether section itself only states 82 Magic and 66 Agility
Cost labels are a judgement: the guide's GP/XP columns are live Grand Exchange price templates with no fixed numbers
